title: Growers market
brief: The original delivery of six crates of display stands to covered market entrance has fallen through. The stallholders association needs a replacement shipment in time for the first trader bookings. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text: I can have someone at the covered market entrance to receive all six crates together by 12:15 today. That’s the latest staffed handover we can accept. An unattended drop isn’t possible. Morgan, when will the crates be ready? Sam, can you quote a service that meets that window? Robin, can you confirm the budget?

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text: We need to book a replacement today for all six crates of display stands in one load to the covered market entrance. Morgan, when can the full load be ready? Quinn, when can you receive it, and when do the first traders need it? Sam, what service can meet that window, and what’s the all-in price? I can approve up to 102 crowns. Please send me the quote before booking.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text: I can release all six crates from 10:30 today. They need to travel together in one vehicle. Quinn, when can you receive them at the covered market entrance, and when do the first traders need them? Sam, can you quote a vehicle for the full load and confirm pickup and arrival times? Robin, can you confirm the budget and approve the quote if it fits?

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I can book one truck for all six crates. Today’s fixed pickup times, guaranteed staffed handover times, and all-in prices are:

| Service | Pickup | Handover by | Crowns |
|---|---|---|---:|
| V260 | 10:57 | 11:40 | 72 |
| V352 | 11:00 | 12:27 | 44 |
| V376 | 10:35 | 12:03 | 55 |
| V433 | 10:54 | 11:52 | 82 |

Morgan, when can all six crates be ready? Quinn, when can you staff the covered market entrance, and what’s the latest handover that works for the traders? Robin, what can you authorize? I’ll book the cheapest service that fits.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I’m tendering V376 for all six crates in one vehicle. It picks up at 10:35 and guarantees staffed handover at the covered market entrance by 12:03 for 55 crowns all in. The 44-crown service misses the 12:15 cutoff. V376 leaves five minutes between release and pickup and 12 minutes before the handover cutoff.

Morgan, confirm the full load can make the 10:35 pickup. Quinn, confirm when your receiver can be in place for handover by 12:03. Robin, please approve the 55-crown quote before I book. If any of those commitments won’t work, please flag the specific timing or cost issue now.

[PROPOSE: V376]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the covered market entrance from 10:35 to receive all six crates together. V376’s guaranteed handover by 12:03 fits our 12:15 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V376]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
V376 fits my 102-crown limit at 55 crowns all in. I approve the expense. Sam, please book once Morgan and Quinn confirm the 10:35 pickup and staffed handover by 12:03.

[APPROVE: V376]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
Quality control is relabeling the crates. I can release all six together from 10:48, so we’ll miss V376’s 10:35 pickup. Sam, please tender V260. I can make its 10:57 pickup, and its 11:40 handover meets Quinn’s cutoff. At 72 crowns, it’s within Robin’s budget.

[HOLD: V376]

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text:
I’m requesting V260 for all six crates in one vehicle at 72 crowns all in. The 10:57 pickup gives Morgan nine minutes after release, and the guaranteed 11:40 staffed handover at the covered market entrance is 35 minutes ahead of Quinn’s cutoff. V376’s pickup is now too early.

Morgan, Quinn, and Robin, please ratify V260 for pickup, staffed handover, and the revised price so I can release the booking.

[BOOK: V260]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the covered market entrance from 10:35 to receive all six crates together. V260’s guaranteed handover by 11:40 meets our 12:15 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V260]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
I authorize 72 crowns all in for V260. The 10:57 pickup is after Morgan’s revised release time, and the guaranteed 11:40 handover fits Quinn’s staffed window.

[APPROVE: V260]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
All six crates will be ready from 10:48. I’ll release them together for V260’s 10:57 pickup.

[APPROVE: V260]
